components.name: Phaser
components.evidence: The production createGame chunks include node_modules/phaser/dist.

components.name: EventEmitter3
components.evidence: Phaser declares EventEmitter3 as its sole runtime dependency and its bundled source identifies the EventEmitter3 wrapper.

components.name: React runtime family
components.evidence: The client framework contains React, React DOM, and Scheduler; the server bundle also identifies React Server DOM Webpack.

components.name: Vinext
components.evidence: Client and server production manifests include Vinext runtime shims.

components.name: Vite React Server Components plugin
components.evidence: The server production bundle includes @vitejs/plugin-rsc runtime modules; the license is from its shared vite-plugin-react repository.

components.name: Rolldown runtime
components.evidence: The client manifest includes the generated Rolldown runtime chunk.

next.reason: Next.js provides the source compatibility contract; production imports are resolved to Vinext shims and no Next.js package module appears in the distribution.
